About

The Creative Process Behind the Designs

I trained as a UX/UI designer at Kyiv Academy of Media Arts, defending a full diploma project, after a year of Business & Computing at Ofi College. I design in Figma — personas, site maps, wireframes, high-fidelity flows — and for select projects I take it further, working with Claude to turn the design into a real, working site in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Most of my case studies are e-commerce and brand landing pages, because that's where research, UI craft and front-end execution all have to hold together at once. Currently looking for my first role, an internship, or freelance UX/UI work.
